description: What Improves Environmental Performance? Evidence from Mexican Industry is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Survey data from Mexico, 1995, which provides detailed information on environmental performance and determinants, including plant, firm and market characteristics, pollution control costs, relationships with regulators, and measures to improve environmental performance. All plant and respondent identities were kept confidential. The data and survey document are all contained in the zip file. Coverage: Mexico. It has 3 files in ZIP, HTML, PDF. The portal files it under Environment. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
